title: Equivalent resistance calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly computes the equivalent resistance of the parallel combination of R2 and R3, then adds it in series with R1.

title: Main circuit current
description: Essential Criteria: The student applies Ohm's law for a complete circuit to find the total current, using the total equivalent resistance and internal resistance.

title: Terminal voltage answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student correctly calculates the terminal voltage U as the EMF minus the voltage drop across the internal resistance.

title: Capacitor voltage
description: Important Criteria: The student recognizes that the voltage across the capacitor equals the voltage across resistor R1 after the circuit stabilizes.

title: Capacitor charge answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student correctly calculates the charge on the capacitor using the formula Q = C * U1.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student demonstrates consistent use of units, correctly handling microfarads to farads in the charge calculation.

title: Misidentifying capacitor voltage
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly assumes the capacitor voltage equals the terminal voltage or the EMF, rather than the voltage across R1.

title: Ignoring internal resistance
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student calculates the terminal voltage without subtracting the voltage drop across the internal resistance.
